name: Focus Field Probe
description: DISPROVEN EXPERIMENT, kept as a record. Tested whether Focus Field's crash came from the (element, status) pairing by giving it wind + Sluggish, which is exactly how Triple Tornado is authored. It crashed anyway, under the same element as the original crash but a different status. The pairing theory is dead; what an elemental move needs is not in combo.GDA. Do not play this ROM.
